teaser-sinking-01.mp4.generated_with: seedance_2_0, Kai-v2 element + approved hero plate as start frame, 8s, 1248x1664, scored
teaser-sinking-01.mp4.status_note: Redone 2026-07-31 with the locked element, which holds identity across the whole clip rather than only at frame 0. The predecessor's real defect was never identity drift - Kai was on-model throughout it - but a push-in so hard that by 2.9s the surface silhouettes and pool floor were both gone and the shot became a generic chest-up view. This take holds the full vertical depth for all 8s: he stays small on the tiled floor and the surface recedes as he sinks. Eyes closed, then the Undertow glow comes up at ~5.2s - canon-correct because he is submerged.
teaser-sinking-01.mp4.verification: 12 frames sampled and inspected; sheet kept at qc/teaser-sinking-01-frames.png
teaser-sinking-01.mp4.audio: Sound bed built from four licensed Splice field recordings: FF_IE_drone_lowest_gravity (Field & Foley) as the Undertow bed, Falling_C_Sub (ModeAudio) for the descent, and two hydrophone recordings (Splice Soundscapes) for submerged room tone and the eye-opening reveal at ~5.2s. Mixed with ffmpeg; no generated audio.
teaser-sinking-01.mp4.audio_verification: -19.4 LUFS integrated, -2.7 dBFS true peak, 1.2 LU range. Speech-band ratio 0.17 (bottom-heavy, no voice). Spectrogram inspected: no sustained mid harmonics. Picture bitstream hash IDENTICAL to the verified silent cut - confirming the mux altered no frame. Re-runnable via qc/verify_audio.py.

kai-neutral-ref.png.note: Kai in his un-powered baseline state: flat neutral daylight, plain background, ordinary dark brown eyes, blue-black hair. Exists so his element cannot mistake the submerged Undertow glow for his permanent face.

bo-neutral-ref.png.note: Flat 2D cel-shaded neutral plate with his eyes open. Replaces a semi-3D CG render that was teaching the wrong house style.

mirei-neutral-ref.png.note: Neutral plate with prescription glasses ON HER FACE, narrow eyes, MANAGER armband, clipboard and stopwatch. Corrects a founding plate that had her bare-faced with sunglasses on her head.

gouda-neutral-ref.png.note: Standing neutral plate, weary and closed, ordinary dark brown eyes. Corrects a founding plate that had him grinning with yellow eyes under a sepia cast.

nakaru-neutral-ref.png.note: Neutral plate in which the grey temple streak and throat scar are legible for the first time. The storm plate hid both.
